status: preregistered; run in progress on the host; no result recorded in this file
revision_note: SmartRouter main at freeze; tools/prices-2.json is identical at this revision and at the branch head that commits this file
host: Claude Code (subscription); sub-agents launched by a workflow script, two at a time
model_identity_note: Requested values are the host's model aliases; resolved immutable model revisions are not exposed to the coordinator and will be recorded as null unless observed

subject.isolation: one git worktree and branch per task and profile, created at the base revision

known_defect.summary: a successful token refresh does not reset the consecutive-identical-answer count, because the tokens branch returns before the reset

source_roles.cal-truth.json: review ground truth (U5-R16, U5-R17); hash only, text not copied into this repository
source_roles.sr-calibration-1-wf_052c5f34-973.js: workflow script holding the task and grader prompts; hash only
source_roles.cal-grade.sh: mechanical grader for pin and fix; copied here as grade.sh (byte-identical)
source_roles.cal-fix-finding.md: the finding text the fix task was given; hash only
source_roles.tools/prices-2.json: price rows for the estimate-only cash column (revision prices-2)

source_hash_convention: SHA-256 of UTF-8 text with CRLF/CR normalized to LF

cases.task: write a red-first pin test for the consecutive-identical-answer rule in a new test file; no source change
cases.pass_rule: the candidate's new test fails at the base revision AND passes with src/main/github-signin.ts from 4151a25 AND no file under src/ is changed
cases.reported_separately: eslint on the candidate's test files; not part of pass_rule because the task instructions did not state a lint criterion (grade.sh's own PASS field includes lint and is therefore not the scored pass)

cases.task: fix U5-R16 from its accepted finding text, red-first, lint, commit
cases.pass_rule: the candidate's tests (tests/github-signin-refresh.test.ts, tests/github-signin.test.ts and any new test files) are green at its head AND its refresh/new tests are red again with src/main/github-signin.ts restored to the base revision AND the accepted pin test from 4151a25 is green against the candidate's source AND every changed file is src/main/github-signin.ts, tests/github-signin-refresh.test.ts or a newly added test file AND eslint is clean on those files

cases.task: refute-first review of the refresh path of src/main/github-signin.ts at the base revision
cases.grading: grader agent (model opus, effort high) against cal-truth.json; read-only access to the candidate's worktree
grader_fields: others (each other S1-S3 finding classified true, false or unverifiable)
cases.pass_rule_note: no composite pass was frozen for review; it is reported field by field

metrics: pass per task (pin, fix) and the grader fields (review)
tokens per item, as reported by the workflow journal
wall_seconds per item, as reported by the workflow journal
accounting: subscription host: no per-call billing or price applies. estimated_cash_usd applies the tools/prices-2.json rows (revision prices-2; haiku -> cloud-C, sonnet -> cloud-S, opus -> cloud-O, fable -> cloud-F) to the harness-reported tokens; when the journal gives no input/output split the estimate is a range from all-input to all-output rates, and cache pricing is not modelled. It is not a bill and supports no savings claim. Unknown tokens are null, never zero.
timing: host-observed wall time per sub-agent from the workflow journal, including scheduling; two items ran concurrently, so wall time is not pure model latency
privacy: the subject repository's own code and test harness only; the ground truth, prompts and finding text are recorded by hash; no credentials or account data
limits: one ground-truth defect (U5-R16): a profile can find or fix it by luck, and one run per profile cannot separate luck from capability

the accepted answer exists in the subject repository's git history; candidates were told not to read history beyond the base revision, and the review grader checks copiedFromHistory; pin and fix have no copy check beyond the mechanical criteria
the host box has 4 CPUs, so agents ran two at a time; wall time includes contention
the pin task's instructions did not state a lint criterion, so a lint failure on pin is a hygiene signal, not a task failure
tokens are the harness's reported counts, not a provider bill
model labels are requested aliases, not verified immutable deployments
no overall model ranking, routing threshold or savings claim follows from this run alone
